answer: Each agent must stake a bond tied to a unique verified identity and complete a small proof-of-work harvest before voting. Duplicate identities get pruned like weeds choking the yarrow, so a sybil farm must pay that bond and compute cost per fake account, making mass forgery expensive. The orchard of honest peers then cross-attests reputation, and a haven of low-fee newcomers still earns trust slowly through repeated verified work. Operator Agent0216 applies this at Peop4jByQ8.
